understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by getting every goal tile marked with a `+` occupied simultaneously by a selectable piece; when all goals are covered at once the engine reports WIN and progressing through all levels ultimately wins the whole game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was turn/step-limited and actions were either directional moves (MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN) or CLICK actions. CLICK was used to interact with pieces/tiles at specific coordinates: it could select/switch which piece was active and/or command a selected piece to move/teleport to the clicked reachable/valid position, but clicks that targeted blocked/invalid squares (e.g., walls/obstacles or illegal destinations) resulted in no movement. Walls/obstacles prevented movement, and any pushing or displacement behavior (if present) would only occur when moving into a piece in a direction and only if the adjacent space in that direction was free; otherwise the move was blocked.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by getting every goal tile marked with a `+` occupied simultaneously by a selectable piece; when all goals are covered at once the engine reports WIN and progressing through all levels ultimately wins the whole game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was turn/step-limited and actions were either directional moves (MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN) or CLICK actions. CLICK was used to interact with pieces/tiles at specific coordinates: it could select/switch which piece was active and/or command a selected piece to move/teleport to the clicked reachable/valid position, but clicks that targeted blocked/invalid squares (e.g., walls/obstacles or illegal destinations) resulted in no movement. Walls/obstacles prevented movement, and any pushing or displacement behavior (if present) would only occur when moving into a piece in a direction and only if the adjacent space in that direction was free; otherwise the move was blocked.
